༄༅/ /bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa lha dang bla ma dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor rta mchog bā la ha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa lha dang bla ma dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor rta mchog bā la ha zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru be/ 'dir bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med dang rnam dbyer med pa'i dbang gi cod pan 'chang ba dril sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom rim nyung bsdus zhig brjod par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshom bu'i steng du 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan nam bla ma'i sku gang 'byor bshams/ mdun du mchod pa nyer spyod rnams dang*/ gtor zlum dang mtheb kyu/ bsang chu sogs nye bar bsags la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med bsgom pa ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum spyi dpal rdo rje can// rtsa gsum kun 'dus rang bzhin mchog /rtag par skyabs mchi sems can rnams// 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum mam bdun/ 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// dga' dang btang snyoms cher gnas shog / lan gsum/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ oṃ las rin chen pad+ma'i snod// rab 'byams rgya khyon bral ba'i nang*// hūm̐ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i// mchod sprin sna tshogs mtha' yas pa// kun bzang rnam thar ji bzhin du// rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces gnas dang*/ yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ gzung 'dzin chos rnams stong pa chen po'i dbyings// ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor sbyangs byas nas// snod bcud lha yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin bsgyur// rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can// sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam mig mang ris// mnan na nem dang btegs na spar byed pa// dpag bsam ljon pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos bskor// dbus su byang chub shing mchog rnam par snang*// de mdun rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir// pad+ma stong ldan chu shel 'od dkar steng*// hriḥdamar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus 'phags pa mchod// 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dus yongs gyur las// mtha' yas 'od mnga' stobs bcu'i dbang phyug mchog

/bcom ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma gsung gi dbang*// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho ni// tshe dang ye shes dpag med ston par gsal// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can 'od zer 'phro// sprul sku'i cha lugs chos gos rnam gsum gsol// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag lhung bzed bcud bkang nas// tshe bum shing lo'i kha rgyan 'dod dgu ster// dbu la gtsug tor zhabs la 'khor lo sogs// mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cus spras// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas bzhugs// g.yas g.yon pad dkar dri med zla dkyil dbus// rgyal sras thu bo 'phags pa byang chub sems// snying rje tshad med thugs rje'i rnam par rol// 'khor ba dong sprug 'dren pa'i bdag nyid can// rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje ni// spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug mngon sum shar// dkar gsal bco lnga'i zla ba nya 'dra'i mdog /longs sku'i chas rdzogs kṛ ṇas nu g.yon bkab// dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan phyag gnyis g.yas// mchog sbyin g.yon pas ut+pal 'dab rgyas 'dzin// zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par gsal// g.yon du byams pa chen po'i stobs 'chang ba// shes rab nyi mas 'gro blo'i mun sel gnyen// kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas smra ba'i dbang*// 'phags pa ma pham mgon por snang ba ni// dmar ser gur gum ge sar mdog ltar 'tsher// longs sku'i chas rdzogs dar dang rin chen brgyan// phyag gnyis chos 'chad ut+pal g.yas g.yon steng*// klu shing ril pa zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs gsal// gzhan yang g.yas g.yon nye ba'i sras chen po// 'jam dpal dpa' bo mthu chen rdo rje 'dzin// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po kun tu bzang po rnams// sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes// sna tshogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs phrin las kyis// 'gro khams rgya mtshor chu zla'i gar rtsed du// sprul pa du mas yang dag lam mchog ston// 'od dang 'od zer ma lus kun tu 'phro// byang chub sems dang nyan thos dge 'dun sde// bar mtshams thams cad lha dang lha mo'i tshogs// mngon par rgyal ba'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la// dwangs shing 'dud pa'i dga' bde'i sim pa bskyed// gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// de las 'od 'phros nub phyogs bde ba can// pad+ma rnam par bkod pa'i zhing khams nas// bla ma 'od dpag med kyi thugs rgyud bskul// brtse ba chen pos dbyings nas rjes dgongs la// lha tshogs ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// char ltar 'bab bzhin gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur// oṃ sarba ta th+wa ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ

ces brjod la spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med gyur// pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan 'bul dang*/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las// 'od zer rab 'phros dbang lha'i tshogs// spyan drangs dbang bskur sku khrus gsol// sangs rgyas rigs lngas rgyas gdab po// zhes dang*/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// dag gtsang mchod yon rgya mtsho 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// dal 'bab rgyun bzang zhabs bsil 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pād+yaṃ/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// yid 'ong me tog dga' tshal rgyas// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// puṣ+pe/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// dri bzang sman spos dud pa'i sprin// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// dhū pe/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// rab tu gsal byed 'od zer 'bar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// ā lo ke/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// sbyar dang byugs pa'i dri bzang po// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// gan+dhe/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// niwid+ya/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// grag stong snyan pa'i rol mo ldir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// shab+da/ ces sogs rol mo sna tshogs 'bul nas/ 'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid bdun// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad la sogs// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// rang byung ye shes dngos grub stsol// srid zhi'i longs spyod char gyi rgyun// maṇ+ḍal dpal 'byor rgya mtshos gang*// gling bzhi gling phran me tog bkra// 'bul bzhes byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

zhes phyi yi mchod pa dang*/ mtshar sdug sgeg mdzes lang tsho can// rdo rje lha mo bcu drug po// rang snang phyag rgya gar gyis rol// gsang ba nang gi mchod pa 'bul// ces nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ mchod bya mchod byed bral ba yi// 'khor gsum dag pa'i mchod pa 'bul// de bzhin nyid mchod dang*/ oṃ/ mkha' khyab rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// āḥ sna tshogs dbyings kyis chos sgra sgrog /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ mtha' bral mi rtog ting 'dzin ldan// rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces phyag 'tshal nas/ kyai ho/ dgongs su gsol lo mgon po thugs rje can// bdag ni thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// kun rtog 'khrul pa'i mi dge sdig pa'i las// snying nas gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags// dag tshangs sgrib par mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol// ces nongs pa bshags nas bsnyen par 'jug pa ni/ mdun bskyed thugs kar zla steng hrīḥdamar mthar// sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor las 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don byas bdag rgyud la// byin gyis brlab cing dngos grub myur thob gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ ci nus bzlas la/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rin chen snod du 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi// gtor ma dwangs shing zag med rgya chen spel// oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ lha rnams ljags hūm̐ rdo rje 'od sbu gus// gtor ma gsol bas gsang gsum dgyes bskyed gyur// a kā ro lan gsum brjod nas phul/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// phyir mi ldog pa'i zhing khams mchog /skyes nas rgyal ba'i lung bstan thob// kun kyang 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces 'dod don gsol/ rjes ni/ mdun bskyed phyi nang snod bcud lha tshogs rnams// gtso bor thim pa de nyid 'od zhu nas// rang nyid la thim lus gang sgrib bzhi dag

/dbang bzhi thob cing sku bzhi mngon du byas// rdo rje bzhi yi ngo bor lhun grub nas// snang srid dag pa rab 'byams ngo bor shar// ces dar gcig phyag chen gyi nyams len lta ba'i ngang la bzhag nas/ de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam ni/ na mo/ bder gshegs gsung gi rdo rje'i bdag nyid can// bden pa grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi legs par byas pa'i bsod nams las// byung ba'i dge tshogs chu rgyun mi zad pa// 'gro rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang la// myur du thob phyir byang chub chen por bsngo// bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i sems can dang*// nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro ba rigs drug rnams// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i duḥkha las grol ste// 'dus byas kun rdzob sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor gzugs// chu bur lta bu nam zhig yal ba'i tshe// don dam rang bzhin gzhi lam 'od gsal gyi// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mngon gyur nas// sngon gyi thugs bskyed zab mo'i smon lam gyis// ston mchog bcom ldan bla ma 'od dpag med// rgyal sras thu bo gnyis bcas dngos byon nas// bde ba can gyi zhing du lam sna drongs// pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skyes nas su// sangs rgyas zhal mthong bla med dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i 'jug pa ji srid par// de srid bar du rlabs chen 'gro don spyod// theg chen smon lam deng 'dir yongs grub shog /tad+ya thā pañca bri ya a ba bho dha na ya swā hā/ ces so// de nas shis pa brjod pa sogs spyi dang mtshungs par bya'o// ces pa g.yu thog chos sde'i sgrub chen bla ma karma bstan pa dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos snron zla'i nya gang ba'i tshes bzang por bkod pa 'gro rnams 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs bde smon yongs 'du'i ljon pa bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo bud+dha bo dhi sa twa bh+ya/ mtha' yas bla na med pa'i snying stobs kyi// dam bcas sa gsum g.yo ba'i thugs rje can// mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur// tshe 'od dpag tu med pa'i skur snang ba// rnam dag zhing gi yon tan lhun rdzogs pa'i// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i pho brang dbus// mtshan dpe'i gzi byin bltar mi mngon par bzhugs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin dbyangs gcig /rab bstod dbugs dbyung du mas gzengs bstod cing*// lhar bcas yongs kyi skyabs yul gnyen gcig pu// spyi bos 'dud pa'i skal bzang cir yang thob// gang zhig 'gro la brtse chen rta bdun gyis// drangs ba'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i 'od stong gi// gong bu gcig tu smin pa'i dpal yon can// 'char ka'i nyin byed ltar dmar cod pan 'dzin// gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen sprul pa'i sku// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho mchog /lus can skal ldan mthong dang thos pa yi// 'brel tshad phyam gcig bde chen sar bkod pa// snang mtha' yas dang dbyings dang ye shes kyi// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa gang 'dul ston// thabs mkhas gdul bya'i mos pa sna tshogs pas// 'dren pa'i ded dpon khyod la gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs bde chen zhing du bgrod gyur cig /g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// g.yon du phyag na rdor 'dzin mthu chen thob// byams pa 'jam dpal kun tu bzang po dang*// nam mkha'i snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// sa yi snying po byang sems nye sras brgyad// lhag pa'i mkhyen brtse lhag pa'i sems bskyed kyi// zla med thugs rje chen po'i snang ba las// mkha' mdangs mi bskyod cod pan 'chang nas su// 'gro sgrol phrin las bdud rtsi'i cha shas gang*// rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// byin rlabs 'od dkar srid zhi'i mun sel mgon// gsol ba 'debs so khyod zhabs bsnyen par smon// rab tu 'phags pa'i sar gnas 'phags pa yi// thugs bskyed go cha btsan po'i snying stobs kyis// log lta bdud ris khri mun zhum pa'i phyir// gzugs sku khyung sngon skyes ltar lung rigs kyis// rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa smra ba'i dbang*// byams mgon dngos snang dharmā kā ra'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin brlabs pa dang*// sgrib gnyis bag chags ma lus sbyang du gsol// de ltar rnam par dag pa'i zhing rnams kun// sku la rdzogs shing sku yi bkod pa ni// zhing khams ma lus gang bar snang ba yi// ston 'khor tha mi dad pa'i phrin las kyis// bskal mang sngon nas byang chub spyad mchog don// 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i snying stobs 'phrul// g.yo ba med bzhin gus pas gsol 'debs na// myur bar thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol// 'byung lnga'i phung khams sgyu lus yal ba'i tshe// rtse gcig skyabs gnas yid kyis 'chang lags na// myur bar thar pa'i lam sna drangs nas su// zhing mchog dam par brdzus te skye bar shog

/de ma thag tu zhal mthong lung bstan thob// sprul pas phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i don la spyod// phyir mi ldog par bde ba can zhing du// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces rdo stod g.yu thog pa'i sgrub chen karma nas rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyi gsol 'debs dang bde smon zung du 'jug pa 'di bzhin bskul bar brten/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel pa sarba dza ga taṃ// shu bhaṃ/// /
